summary: Server track-state signal dispatch. Runs StateCheckWrapper on this to obtain an object state flag; when the state check fails, forwards to ServerOpenedClosedNotification on the dereferenced this+0 pointer. When the state check passes, dispatches a2-driven ServerOpenTrackSignal (a2 non-zero) or ServerCloseTrackSignal (a2 zero). Invoked by WeatherSurfaceUpdate (004628a0).

local_names.this: object whose this+0 pointer is dereferenced and passed to the server signal helpers
local_names.a2: open/close selector; non-zero selects open, zero selects close
local_names.v3: StateCheckWrapper result deciding which dispatch path runs
local_names.v4: dereferenced this+0 value forwarded as the server signal target

operations.description: StateCheckWrapper(this) returns the state flag v3 that selects the dispatch path
Dereference this+0 into v4, the pointer/value forwarded to the server signal helpers
When v3 is zero (state check failed), return ServerOpenedClosedNotification(v4, a2) and skip the open/close dispatch
When the state check passed and a2 is non-zero, return ServerOpenTrackSignal(v4)
When the state check passed and a2 is zero, return ServerCloseTrackSignal(v4); called by WeatherSurfaceUpdate (004628a0)
